definitions: An acronym for Incident Command System, a standardized on-scene management system designed to allow its users to adopt an integrated organizational structure equal to the complexity and demands of single or multiple incidents without being hindered by jurisdictional boundaries.

An acronym for Industrial Control System, a general term that encompasses several types of control systems and associated instrumentation, including supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, distributed control systems (DCS), and smaller control systems often found in the industrial sector such as programmable logic controllers (PLC) and other control loop components.
examples: The fire department implemented ICS at the scene.
Security vulnerabilities in ICS are a major concern.
Training in ICS is crucial for emergency responders.
